title: Consistent Naming: Crimson & Warped
description: A simple pack that renames Nether items to maintain a consistent naming scheme!
body:
A simple pack that renames Nether items to maintain a consistent naming scheme!

This pack renames the following:
- Nether Wart -> Crimson Wart
- Nether Wart Block -> Crimson Wart Block
- Red Nether Brick (Slab, Stair, Wall) -> Crimson Nether Brick (Slab, Stair, Wall)
- Weeping Vines -> Crimson Vines
- Twisting Vines -> Warped Vines
- Nether Sprouts -> Warped Sprouts

There is an option without the Vine renames if you, like me, prefer the unique names Mojang came up with.
